title: To me doing history also needs to begin with yourself. How are we teaching children to shape their own digital archive? They need places to mess up on
summary: To me doing history also needs to begin with yourself. How are we teaching children to shape their own digital archive? They need places to mess up online and be themselves, but we should help them learn to own their own histories and data #sschat
